mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM runtime_turn WHERE id = #{turnId} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND status = 'RUNNING' FOR SHARE
UPDATE runtime_thread SET last_item_seq = last_item_seq + 1, update_at = now() WHERE id = #{threadId} RETURNING last_item_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runtime_item ( thread_id, seq, id, turn_id, step, type, role, content_json, token_count, data_label, discarded, schema_ref, outcome, reason_code, model_ref, output_mode, repair_rounds, create_at, create_by ) VALUES ( #{threadId}, #{seq}, #{id}, #{turnId}, #{step}, #{type}, #{role}, #{contentJson}, #{tokenCount}, #{dataLabel}, COALESCE(#{discarded}, FALSE), #{schemaRef}, #{outcome}, #{reasonCode}, #{modelRef}, #{outputMode}, #{repairRounds}, now(), 'system' )
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, schema_ref AS schemaRef, outcome, reason_code AS reasonCode, model_ref AS modelRef, output_mode AS outputMode, repair_rounds AS repairRounds, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY seq LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE create_at >= #{from} AND create_at <= #{to} ORDER BY create_at, id
